## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Reproducible evidence

Explain how the change was verified. Include commands, test names, expected
results, and observed results where useful.

## Documentation and compatibility

- [ ] Documentation and user-facing release notes are updated when needed.
- [ ] The change does not introduce credentials, private data, or undisclosed
      security details.
- [ ] Compatibility and migration impact are described, or are not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] I tested the change against a public source snapshot.
- [ ] I added or updated focused tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I included a minimal reproducer or test evidence for the reported problem.
- [ ] I removed secrets and personal data from the branch and the description.
